"""
A = T ⊗ P
                    where 
                    T: ℝ ^ (a×b): a sequence
                    P: ℝ ^ (c×d): a sequence
"""
import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, T, P):
        T = np.asarray(T, dtype=np.float64)
        P = np.asarray(P, dtype=np.float64)
        a = T.shape[0]
        b = T.shape[1]
        c = P.shape[0]
        d = P.shape[1]
        assert T.shape == (a, b)
        assert P.shape == (c, d)
        # A = T ⊗ P
        self.A = np.kron(T, P)
